main.title: About me

p1.been: I'm Alfredo. I've spent over 10 years building things for the web, from simple sites to full platforms used by thousands of people. As a FrontEnd Engineer, I obsess over the small details that make a digital product feel right to use, working across the Vue, Nuxt, and TailwindCSS ecosystem.

p2.text: These days I'm focused full-time on {bitlanlab}, my own software consultancy, and in my free time I'm building {dondecafe}, a side project of mine. Before that I worked at {charly}, migrating stores to Shopify and integrating Salesforce; at {pemex}, building a contract management platform; and at {devSalsa}, developing {joinBrands}, a UGC platform for content creators.

main.p3: I'm passionate about the intersection of product, engineering, and developer experience. I care about Open Source, minimalism, and lately, playing with AI to make life easier for myself and whoever uses what I build — always with a good cappuccino on the side.

p4.text: I was born and raised in León, Guanajuato, Mexico, where I studied Computer Systems Engineering. Outside of work, I love playing sports, attending concerts, walking with Puppy, and {travelling}.
